name: Original Vilverin Athletics walk control

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local Actor=types.Actor
local t=0;local age=0;local frames=0;local rt=0;local st=0;local origin=nil
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if not origin then origin=self.position end
 age=age+dt;frames=frames+1
 if not core.isWorldPaused() and (self.controls.movement~=0 or self.controls.sideMovement~=0) then
  if Actor.isSwimming(self) then st=st+dt elseif self.controls.run and not self.controls.sneak then rt=rt+dt end
 end
 t=t+dt;if t<.1 then return end;t=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during original Athletics control')
 print('Athletics sample run='..tostring(self.controls.run)..' swim='..tostring(Actor.isSwimming(self))..' rt='..rt..' st='..st..' forward='..self.controls.movement..' base='..types.NPC.stats.skills.athletics(self).base..' progress='..types.NPC.stats.skills.athletics(self).progress..' position='..tostring(self.position))
 local delta=self.position-origin
 if math.sqrt(delta.x*delta.x+delta.y*delta.y)>25 then print('Athletics walked distance') end
 if age>=3 and frames>=30 then print('Athletics ready') end
end}}}}
